project_type: Python FastAPI backend - Deep Research Agent with RAG over private project files
build_system: pip with pyproject.toml, editable install with pip install -e '.[dev]'
test_framework: pytest with httpx TestClient for API tests
verification_instructions: 1. Run python3.12 -m pip install -e '.[dev]' to install. 2. Run python3.12 -m pytest tests/ -v to run all tests. 3. Start server with python3.12 -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000 and test endpoints manually if needed.
environment_constraints: Python 3.12 available at /usr/bin/python3.12. Default python3 is 3.9 so always use python3.12 explicitly. Network access available for pip installs. No Docker daemon available.
contribution_requirements: No CONTRIBUTING.md. Follow existing code patterns: dataclasses for models, FastAPI for endpoints, in-memory store pattern.
key_patterns: Models use @dataclass in app/models.py. Store is InMemoryStore class in app/store.py. Pipeline handles parse/chunk/embed in app/pipeline.py. Main FastAPI app in app/main.py. Tests use direct store instantiation and httpx for API-level tests.
directory_structure: app/ - main application (main.py, models.py, pipeline.py, store.py). tests/ - test files. docs/ - architecture.md, wireframes.md. Root: pyproject.toml, openapi.yaml, README.md
